# font8x8 Basic Latin

Daniel Hepper's public-domain bitmap contains the 128 Basic Latin glyphs.
The original header credits Marcel Sondaar and IBM's public-domain VGA font.

Source revision `8e279d2d864e79128e96188a6b9526cfa3fbfef9` and SHA-256
`49d8df366296b203ca3211bc0672cf2a762135bf12710735b6292756b19dffd5`.
The local header adds `#pragma once` and declares the bitmap as a C++ constant
array of unsigned bytes. [Pinned source](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/dhepper/font8x8/8e279d2d864e79128e96188a6b9526cfa3fbfef9/font8x8_basic.h)
